annotations.title: Request a wash or groom appointment

description: Request a mobile wash or full groom, for one dog or up to four, at a time from get_available_slots (call it with the same dogs/grooms counts). IMPORTANT: this files a booking REQUEST — the owner confirms it shortly afterward and the customer then receives the confirmation email; nothing is charged now, payment is at the door. Before calling, confirm with the customer: the exact time (Pacific Time), name, email, service address, and each dog's size + wash/groom; if check_service_area said a travel fee applies, confirm they accept it and pass travel_fee_ok. One dog washed: dog_size is enough. Several dogs or any groom: use dogs. First-time customers: apply promo WASH10 ($10 off). Fill optional fields from conversation; don't interrogate.

addons.description: Single-dog bookings: paid extras the customer wants. Nail trim, ear cleaning and brush-out are already included.

address.description: REQUIRED: the service address where the van comes (street, city).

dog_name.description: Single-dog bookings: the dog's name (nice to have).

dog_size.description: Single dog getting a WASH: its size tier (sets the price). Ask weight/breed if unsure (Small <20 lbs, Medium 20–60, Large 60–100, XL/Giant 100+). Omit when using dogs.

dogs.description: One entry per dog (up to 4 per visit). Use this for more than one dog or for a full groom; each dog gets its own service and extras.

addons.description: Paid extras for this dog, if wanted.

service.description: wash = full bath, blow-dry, nails, ears, brush-out. groom = everything in the wash PLUS full haircut, face/feet/sanitary trim, paw pads.

size.description: Size tier (Small <20 lbs, Medium 20–60, Large 60–100, XL/Giant 100+).

email.description: Customer's email (confirmation arrives here after owner approval).

notes.description: Anything else: parking notes, gate codes, coat condition, matting, skunk emergency, behavior notes.

phone.description: Customer's phone — strongly recommended so the owner can reach them.

promo.description: Promo code. Use WASH10 for first-time customers.

start.description: Chosen slot start as a UTC ISO string, exactly as returned by get_available_slots.

travel_fee_ok.description: true only if check_service_area reported a travel fee and the customer agreed to it.
